case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO…………/2023 [ARISING OUT OF SLP (CRL) NO. 1249/2023]

parties.respondent: The State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr.

summary: SC/ST Act, sec. 3(1)(x) scrutiny; public view requirement unmet; no identification of victim's caste in complaint; absence of third-party witnesses; caste-specific slurs not specified; quashing of charges under SC/ST Act granted while IPC offenses proceed; High Court judgment modified to exclude SC/ST charges.
legal_provisions_cited: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.3(1)(x)
final_judgment: Appeal partly allowed; charges under SC/ST Act quashed; criminal proceedings under IPC sections 323 and 504 upheld.
